blocks.text: Takeaways:
blocks.zh: 外卖:
blocks.en: Takeaways:

blocks.text: 94% of Singapore small business owners surveyed agree that small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI, according to YouGov research commissioned by Meta.
blocks.zh: 94%接受调查的新加坡小企业主同意,小企业需要更多的指导才能获得大赦国际的充分利益,根据YouGov公司委托进行的研究
blocks.en: 94% of Singapore small business owners surveyed agree that small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI, according to YouGov research commissioned by Meta.

blocks.text: Meta Upskill Day 2026 brought Singapore small businesses, heartland merchants and creator-entrepreneurs together for practical training on Meta Business Agents and AI-powered business tools.
blocks.zh: Meta Upskill Day 2026 带来了新加坡的小企业,心脏地带商人和创作者-企业家共同进行关于Meta Business Agents和AI动力商业工具的实践培训.
blocks.en: Meta Upskill Day 2026 brought Singapore small businesses, heartland merchants and creator-entrepreneurs together for practical training on Meta Business Agents and AI-powered business tools.

blocks.text: Meta Upskill Day forms part of the Met a Small Business Growth Academy, which helps small businesses build practical digital and AI skills.
blocks.zh: Meta Upskill Day是小型商业增长学院的一部分,帮助小企业建立实用的数码和人工智能技能。
blocks.en: Meta Upskill Day forms part of the Met a Small Business Growth Academy, which helps small businesses build practical digital and AI skills.

blocks.text: Today, Meta brought over 180 small businesses, heartland merchants and creator-entrepreneurs together at Meta Upskill Day 2026 in Singapore, part of its Small Business Growth Academy, with Guest of Honor Ms Low Yen Ling, Senior Minister of State, Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth & Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry, in attendance. The Academy helps owners use Meta’s digital and AI-enabled tools to find customers, improve productivity and grow. Through hands-on Business Agent training, demonstrations and discussions with Meta experts, participants explored how to apply these tools to their everyday business needs.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...梅塔带来了180多家小企业,在新加坡的2026年Meta Upskill日,其小企业增长学院的一部分,与嘉宾 低延玲女士,高级国务部长,文化部,社区和青年及能源部,贸易和工业,出席者人数。学院帮助所有者使用Meta的数码和人工智能工具来寻找客户,提高生产力和增长。通过实训业务代理,与Meta专家的示威和讨论,与会者探讨了如何将这些工具应用于日常业务需要。
blocks.en: Today, Meta brought over 180 small businesses, heartland merchants and creator-entrepreneurs together at Meta Upskill Day 2026 in Singapore, part of its Small Business Growth Academy, with Guest of Honor Ms Low Yen Ling, Senior Minister of State, Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth & Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry, in attendance. The Academy helps owners use Meta’s digital and AI-enabled tools to find customers, improve productivity and grow. Through hands-on Business Agent training, demonstrations and discussions with Meta experts, participants explored how to apply these tools to their everyday business needs.

blocks.text: In Singapore, this focus on practical skills aligns with the National AI Strategy’s emphasis on broadening AI adoption and building the capabilities to use it effectively. It also complements the National AI Impact Programme’s objective of helping enterprises deepen their use of AI. By combining hands-on training with outreach through Enterprise Singapore’s (EnterpriseSG) partnership with the Heartland Enterprise Centre Singapore’s (HECS) business advisors and heartland merchant network, the Academy equips business advisors with AI knowledge and practical tools that can support local businesses in exploring AI applications for customer engagement and everyday operations.
blocks.zh: 在新加坡,这种注重实际技能的做法符合《国家人工智能战略》关于扩大人工智能收养范围并建设有效利用人工智能的能力的强调。它还补充了国家AI影响方案帮助企业深化对AI的使用的目标.通过新加坡企业(企业SG)与新加坡心脏地带企业中心(HECS)商业顾问的伙伴关系,将实际操作培训与外联相结合和心脏地带商网,学院为商业顾问提供AI知识和实用工具,这些知识和工具可以支持当地企业探索AI应用,促进客户参与和日常参与。操作。
blocks.en: In Singapore, this focus on practical skills aligns with the National AI Strategy’s emphasis on broadening AI adoption and building the capabilities to use it effectively. It also complements the National AI Impact Programme’s objective of helping enterprises deepen their use of AI. By combining hands-on training with outreach through Enterprise Singapore’s (EnterpriseSG) partnership with the Heartland Enterprise Centre Singapore’s (HECS) business advisors and heartland merchant network, the Academy equips business advisors with AI knowledge and practical tools that can support local businesses in exploring AI applications for customer engagement and everyday operations.

blocks.text: YouGov Research
blocks.zh: YouGov 研究软件
blocks.en: YouGov Research

blocks.text: New YouGov research commissioned by Meta found that 94% of small business owners surveyed in Singapore agree that small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI.
blocks.zh: Meta委托的New YouGov研究发现,在新加坡接受调查的94%的小企业主都同意,小企业需要更多的指导才能从中充分受益.大赦国际。
blocks.en: New YouGov research commissioned by Meta found that 94% of small business owners surveyed in Singapore agree that small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI.

blocks.text: The same research found that 82% of Singapore small business owners surveyed whose business has used AI report a positive impact on productivity over the past 12 months. Among Singapore small business owners who report a positive impact on productivity, 62% use time saved through AI to improve the quality of existing work.
blocks.zh: 同一研究还发现,82%的新加坡小企业主调查其企业使用人工智能报告在过去12个月中对生产力产生了积极影响。在报告对生产力产生积极影响的新加坡小企业主中,62%利用人工智能节省的时间来提高现有工作的质量。
blocks.en: The same research found that 82% of Singapore small business owners surveyed whose business has used AI report a positive impact on productivity over the past 12 months. Among Singapore small business owners who report a positive impact on productivity, 62% use time saved through AI to improve the quality of existing work.

blocks.text: “Our focus is helping Singapore’s small businesses find customers, improve productivity and grow by pairing practical digital and AI tools with training. Honeymill uses WhatsApp Business to build customer relationships, while SpeakEasy Lab uses Meta Business Agent to handle routine enquiries and give its founders more time for personal conversations. These examples show how digital tools can help small teams serve customers and compete more effectively,” said Nicole Tan, Managing Director of Meta Singapore.
blocks.zh: “我们的重点是帮助新加坡的小企业找到顾客,将实用的数码和人工智能工具与培训相结合,从而提高生产力和增长。Honeymill使用WhatsApp Business来建立客户关系,而SpeakEasy Lab则使用Meta Business Agent来处理日常查询,并给其创始人更多的时间进行个人对话.这些例子说明数字工具如何能帮助小团队为顾客服务,担任Meta Singapore总裁.
blocks.en: “Our focus is helping Singapore’s small businesses find customers, improve productivity and grow by pairing practical digital and AI tools with training. Honeymill uses WhatsApp Business to build customer relationships, while SpeakEasy Lab uses Meta Business Agent to handle routine enquiries and give its founders more time for personal conversations. These examples show how digital tools can help small teams serve customers and compete more effectively,” said Nicole Tan, Managing Director of Meta Singapore.

blocks.text: Putting Meta Business Agent to Work
blocks.zh: 将 Meta 业务代理安装到工作
blocks.en: Putting Meta Business Agent to Work

blocks.text: Customer engagement is one area where owners see opportunities for AI. In Singapore, 52% of small business owners surveyed have used or would be interested in using AI-powered customer responses.
blocks.zh: 客户参与是业主看到AI机会的一个领域.在新加坡,52%接受调查的小企业主已经使用或有兴趣使用AI授权的客户反应。
blocks.en: Customer engagement is one area where owners see opportunities for AI. In Singapore, 52% of small business owners surveyed have used or would be interested in using AI-powered customer responses.

blocks.text: The Business Agent masterclass gave participants hands-on experience alongside demonstrations and guidance from Meta’s Business Messaging experts. The sessions explored how businesses can use agents to support customer enquiries through WhatsApp and Messenger, giving their teams more time to focus on other parts of the business.
blocks.zh: 商务代理大师班为参与者提供了亲身体验,以及Meta的商务消息专家的演示和指导。这些会议探讨了企业如何利用代理人通过WhatsApp和Messer支持客户查询,给他们的团队更多的时间 专注于其他部分的业务。
blocks.en: The Business Agent masterclass gave participants hands-on experience alongside demonstrations and guidance from Meta’s Business Messaging experts. The sessions explored how businesses can use agents to support customer enquiries through WhatsApp and Messenger, giving their teams more time to focus on other parts of the business.

blocks.text: For Singapore communication training business SpeakEasy Lab, that support helps a two-person team manage routine enquiries while its founders step in when customers need personalised advice. According to the business, routine questions that previously took around an hour or longer to answer now receive almost immediate responses. The founders estimate that Meta Business Agent saves their team 10 to 15 working hours each week.
blocks.zh: 为新加坡的交流培训企业 SpeakEasy Lab,这种支持帮助一个两人小组管理例行查询,而其创始人则在客户需要个性化建议时介入.据企业说,先前用一个小时或更长时间回答的例行问题现在几乎立即得到答复。创始人估计,Meta Business Agent每周会节省他们的团队10到15个工作小时.
blocks.en: For Singapore communication training business SpeakEasy Lab, that support helps a two-person team manage routine enquiries while its founders step in when customers need personalised advice. According to the business, routine questions that previously took around an hour or longer to answer now receive almost immediate responses. The founders estimate that Meta Business Agent saves their team 10 to 15 working hours each week.

blocks.text: “For a small business like ours, every enquiry matters. Meta Business Agent helps us respond to customers quickly, even when we’re teaching or away, while saving us 10 to 15 hours every week. That means we can spend less time answering routine questions and more time understanding and connecting with our learners as we grow,” said Mervyn Ye, Co-founder of SpeakEasy Lab.
blocks.zh: “对于像我们这样的小企业,每一个调查都很重要。Meta Business Agent帮助我们迅速回应客户,即使我们教书或离开,每周节省10到15个小时这意味着我们可以花更少的时间回答例行问题, 更多的时间理解和联系我们的学习者,SpeakEasy Lab的联合创始人.
blocks.en: “For a small business like ours, every enquiry matters. Meta Business Agent helps us respond to customers quickly, even when we’re teaching or away, while saving us 10 to 15 hours every week. That means we can spend less time answering routine questions and more time understanding and connecting with our learners as we grow,” said Mervyn Ye, Co-founder of SpeakEasy Lab.

blocks.text: Helping Businesses Create More Video With Dream Render
blocks.zh: 帮助企业用梦想渲染器创建更多视频
blocks.en: Helping Businesses Create More Video With Dream Render

blocks.text: Creating content is another practical area for support. In Singapore, 46% of small business owners surveyed say AI training for marketing and content creation would be useful. That’s why alongside practical training on Meta Business Agent, Meta is also introducing Dream Render, an AI-powered web app for small businesses and creators who need to produce product videos regularly. It turns a short product description or photo into a first draft in minutes. Users can adjust individual shots, framing, pacing, voiceover and on-screen text, then preview and approve before the final video is produced. They download and publish the video themselves as social content or ads, with a label showing it was made with AI.
blocks.zh: 创造内容是另一个需要支持的实际领域。在新加坡,接受调查的46%的小企业主说,关于营销和内容制作的人工智能培训将是有益的。因此,除了关于Meta Business Agent的实践培训外,Meta也在介绍Dream Render,为需要定期制作产品视频的小企业和创作者提供AI驱动的网络应用程序。它在几分钟内将一个简短的产品描述或照片变成初稿.用户可以调整个人镜头,框架,节奏,语音和屏幕上文本,然后在制作最后视频之前进行预览和批准。他们下载和发布 视频本身作为社交内容或广告,上面贴着一个标签 上面写着是AI做的
blocks.en: Creating content is another practical area for support. In Singapore, 46% of small business owners surveyed say AI training for marketing and content creation would be useful. That’s why alongside practical training on Meta Business Agent, Meta is also introducing Dream Render, an AI-powered web app for small businesses and creators who need to produce product videos regularly. It turns a short product description or photo into a first draft in minutes. Users can adjust individual shots, framing, pacing, voiceover and on-screen text, then preview and approve before the final video is produced. They download and publish the video themselves as social content or ads, with a label showing it was made with AI.

blocks.text: “Dream Render gives small businesses a quick starting point for product video, with the controls to shape it for their products and customers. Through Meta Upskill Day and partners such as Enterprise Singapore, we’re helping owners build the skills and confidence to put AI to work,” added Tan.
blocks.zh: “Dream Render为小企业提供了产品视频的快速起点,用来塑造他们的产品和客户。通过Meta Upskill Day和新加坡企业等合作伙伴,帮助所有者建立技能与信心,
blocks.en: “Dream Render gives small businesses a quick starting point for product video, with the controls to shape it for their products and customers. Through Meta Upskill Day and partners such as Enterprise Singapore, we’re helping owners build the skills and confidence to put AI to work,” added Tan.

blocks.text: The tool runs in a browser at dreamrender.com, giving businesses and creators another way to develop product content while managing the everyday demands of running a business. People can sign in with the Facebook profile page or Instagram professional account they already use, with nothing to download or install.
blocks.zh: 该工具在Dreamrender.com的浏览器中运行,给企业和创造者以另一种方法来开发产品内容,同时管理经营企业的日常需求。人们可以用他们已经使用过的Facebook简介页面或Instagram专业账户签名,没有下载或安装。
blocks.en: The tool runs in a browser at dreamrender.com, giving businesses and creators another way to develop product content while managing the everyday demands of running a business. People can sign in with the Facebook profile page or Instagram professional account they already use, with nothing to download or install.

blocks.text: Singaporean startup Haldy, which makes sugar-free turmeric mints, has been using Dream Render for their video needs. “Dream Render has been a game changer for accelerating Haldy’s social media presence in a short span of time. We love how effortless it is to produce high-quality content that resonates with our consumers in Singapore and beyond,” said Push Sharma, Founder & CEO of Haldy.
blocks.zh: 新加坡创业者Haldy,使无糖的薄荷,一直用Dream Render来满足他们的视频需求。Dream Render在短时间内加速了Haldy社交媒体的存在,Push Sharma说, “我们喜欢制作与新加坡内外消费者共鸣的高质量内容,哈尔迪的创始人兼CEO.
blocks.en: Singaporean startup Haldy, which makes sugar-free turmeric mints, has been using Dream Render for their video needs. “Dream Render has been a game changer for accelerating Haldy’s social media presence in a short span of time. We love how effortless it is to produce high-quality content that resonates with our consumers in Singapore and beyond,” said Push Sharma, Founder & CEO of Haldy.

blocks.text: Supporting Singapore’s Small Business Community
blocks.zh: 支持新加坡小企业界
blocks.en: Supporting Singapore’s Small Business Community

blocks.text: Since its launch in Singapore in 2021, Upskill with Meta has trained more than 500+ small businesses and upskilled over 4,500 entrepreneurs. Meta has worked with government partners including Digital Industry Singapore, AI Singapore, EnterpriseSG and the Singapore Economic Development Board to help local businesses transform their operations with digital and AI tools.
blocks.zh: 自2021年在新加坡发布以来,Upskill with Meta已经培训了500多个小企业,并培养了4,500多名企业家。Meta与包括新加坡数字工业在内的政府合作伙伴合作,AI 新加坡,EntertainmentSG和新加坡经济发展委员会帮助当地企业用数字和AI工具改造业务.
blocks.en: Since its launch in Singapore in 2021, Upskill with Meta has trained more than 500+ small businesses and upskilled over 4,500 entrepreneurs. Meta has worked with government partners including Digital Industry Singapore, AI Singapore, EnterpriseSG and the Singapore Economic Development Board to help local businesses transform their operations with digital and AI tools.

blocks.text: About the Research
blocks.zh: 关于研究
blocks.en: About the Research

blocks.text: The research was commissioned by Meta and conducted online by YouGov among 3,983 small business owners across Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong. Data was collected between 6 August and 2 September 2026. Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.
blocks.zh: 这项研究由Meta委托YouGov在澳大利亚全国3 983个小企业主中在线进行,新加坡越南印度尼西亚,台湾印度泰国日本与香港.数据采集于2026年8月6日至9月2日期间.在每个市场,配额按企业规模适用,以在企业之间实现广泛和平衡的分布,为1至9个。10–19和20–49名员工.研究结果为每个市场的各类小企业提供了深入的见解,而不是代表全国的小企业人口。在所调查的9个市场中,所报告的采用和影响各不相同。这些差异可能部分反映了每个市场的所有者如何解释这些问题,以及翻译和地方调查答复规范。
blocks.en: The research was commissioned by Meta and conducted online by YouGov among 3,983 small business owners across Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong. Data was collected between 6 August and 2 September 2026. Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.
